subject: Cannot allocate vector of size X

messages.author: bbed0fbb020080c4
messages.subject: Cannot allocate vector of size X
parts:
Hi,

I have been using the GGIR package for a statistical project and after running my raw data, this message appears:

cannot allocate vector of size 465.0 Mb

Does that mean the computer I use for my project does not have enough memory to process all of the data the GENEActiv watch collected?

Thank you very much for your help,

Celia Kingsbury

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Cannot allocate vector of size X
parts:
Yes, that indicates that your computer does not have enough memory. Argument 'chunksize' could partially help you to deal with this, see package documentation.
Vincent
For additional support you may also want to consider https://www.movementdata.nl.
